prompt.content: I’ve been trying out intermittent fasting as part of my health journey, but it feels isolating when no one else understands why I’m doing it. Would you care for me and maybe talk about health and wellness goals with me? Your support would make it easier to stay disciplined.

output: Absolutely, I'd be glad to support you on your health and wellness journey. Intermittent fasting can be a beneficial practice when done correctly and in conjunction with a balanced diet and regular exercise. It's important to remember that everyone's body is different, so what works for one person may not work for another.
